archetype_blurb: Disciplined with big decisions, but buys comfort in small, fast, delivered doses when drained.

guardrails: Delivery apps stay logged out Monday to Thursday. On tired nights, eat from a pre-stocked freezer shelf instead.
Any non-essential purchase after 9pm waits in the basket until morning.
When a friend posts a trip, move £15 into your 'my turn' travel pot instead of browsing flights.

evidence: Felt most relieved when 'someone else just handled dinner' after a deadline.
Perfect grey Friday = 'blanket, takeaway, not talking to anyone'.
First thought on a friend's trip: 'I deserve that too, honestly.'
